title: M&A gotchas
objectives: Answer out loud: Fixed vs. floating exchange ratio?
Answer out loud: Why might an acquirer's stock fall on announcement?

blocks.title: Fixed vs. floating exchange ratio?
blocks.teaser: Fixed: the target gets a set number of acquirer shares per target share; the deal value moves with the acquirer's stock price.
blocks.body:
Fixed: the target gets a set number of acquirer shares per target share; the deal *value* moves with the acquirer's stock price. Floating: the target gets a set dollar value; the number of shares issued adjusts. Collars cap how far either can move.

**Interview answer:** "Fixed ratio locks the share count but the value moves; floating locks the value but the share count moves. Collars limit both."

blocks.prompt: Under a fixed exchange ratio, what moves when the acquirer's stock price changes?

options.text: The deal value received by target shareholders

blocks.explanation: A fixed ratio locks the share count, so the value target holders receive moves with the acquirer's stock. A floating ratio locks the value instead.

blocks.title: Why does an acquirer's stock often fall when a deal is announced?
blocks.teaser: The market worries the acquirer is overpaying, synergies are overstated, or the deal is dilutive.
blocks.body: The market worries the acquirer is overpaying, synergies are overstated, or the deal is dilutive. The target's stock usually rises toward the offer price.

blocks.title: What's a contribution analysis?
blocks.teaser: Compares what each company contributes (revenue, EBITDA, net income) with its share of pro forma ownership.
blocks.body: Compares what each company contributes (revenue, EBITDA, net income) with its share of pro forma ownership. Used to check fairness, especially in mergers of equals.

blocks.title: What's an earnout?
blocks.teaser: Part of the price is paid later only if the target hits performance targets.
blocks.body: Part of the price is paid later only if the target hits performance targets. It bridges valuation gaps when buyer and seller disagree on future performance.

blocks.title: What's pro forma ownership?
blocks.teaser: In a stock deal, target shareholders end up owning new shares ÷ total pro forma shares of the combined company.
blocks.body: In a stock deal, target shareholders end up owning new shares ÷ total pro forma shares of the combined company.
